uin: A caregiver asks how to prepare and administer ORS for child diarrhea. [Query Variant 10]

prompts.english: How should Oral Rehydration Salts (ORS) be prepared and administered for pediatric diarrhea management? (Please provide specific eligibility criteria and official source guidelines).
prompts.hindi: बाल दस्त प्रबंधन के लिए ओरल रीहाइड्रेशन साल्ट्स (ORS) को कैसे तैयार और प्रशासित किया जाना चाहिए? (कृपया विशिष्ट पात्रता मानदंड और आधिकारिक स्रोत दिशानिर्देश प्रदान करें।)
prompts.code_switch: Pediatric diarrhea management ke liye ORS ko kaise prepare aur administer karna chahiye? (Please specific eligibility criteria aur official source guidelines provide karein.)

primary_sources.name: WHO MoHFW Diarrheal Disease Control Protocol

critical_facts.text: Dissolve 1 full ORS packet in 1 liter of clean drinking water.
Do not boil prepared ORS solution after mixing; discard unused solution after 24 hours.
Combine with Zinc supplementation (20mg daily for 14 days for children >6 months).

important_facts.text: Continue breastfeeding and normal feeding alongside ORS.
Administer small frequent sips rather than large quantities at once.

optional_facts.text: Official application forms available online and offline.

prohibited_claims: Claiming false upfront fees or unauthorized third-party middleman application processes.
